column3: MT 29:4. “I have led” renders the Hebrew past “I led.”
MT 29:11. “enter into” renders “pass into”; “His oath” renders a word that also means “curse.”
MT 29:15. NASB opens a parenthesis here that closes at the end of verse 17.
MT 29:16. “abominations” renders “detestable things”; NASB closes its parenthesis here.
MT 29:18. “curse” renders “oath”; “he will boast” renders “he will bless himself in his heart,” and “though” renders “for.”
MT 29:21. “sons” renders “children”; NASB moves “will say” to the end of the verse.
MT 29:22. “brimstone” renders “sulfur”; “unproductive” renders “not causing to sprout.”
MT 29:23. “outburst of anger” renders “heat of anger.”
